From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@zenwell.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@zenwell.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery — recap & next steps

Jordan / Aisha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have alignment.

High-level goals you shared:
- Move from pilot to production for context-aware triage by Q3 (targeting 3M API calls/month).
- Ensure any vendor meets SOC 2 Type II controls for data access, logging, and incident response.
- Keep PHI out of vendor-managed storage; prefer customer-managed keying or strong in-flight encryption.

Top pain points:
- Lack of auditable request/response logs tied to user IDs (current system logs are ephemeral).
- Concerns about data retention and eDiscovery for incident investigations.
- Procurement needs standard DPA + pen test evidence to sign off with legal/compliance.

Specific items we discussed / you asked for:
1) Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and scope (which services included).
2) Penetration test summary and remediation timeline for any findings.
3) Details on audit logs: retention windows, search/export capabilities, and per-API-key segregation.
4) DPA with redline capability and our standard security addendum (we can provide a draft).
5) Options for customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and network isolation (VPC peering or private deployment).
6) SLAs for Dedicated/private deployments and escalation path for incidents.

Next steps (ownership / timeline):
- Neha (me): package SOC2 report, pen test summary, DPA draft; target to share artifacts by EOD tomorrow (Mar 12).
- Jordan: confirm which ZenWell teams should receive artifacts (legal, security, infra) and preferred doc share location.
- Joint: schedule a 60-min technical review with your infra/security team week of Mar 16 to walk audit logs and key management options.

If that aligns, I will send the artifacts + a short Loom showing where to find logs in the console and a proposed 3-step onboarding plan for a Dedicated trial.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. That matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Recipients for artifacts: Please share with legal@zenwell.com, security@zenwell.com, and infra-ops@zenwell.com. Legal will want the DPA draft; security needs the pen test summary and SOC scope details.

Jordan / Aisha / Legal team — attaching the artifacts we discussed. Below is a short summary and next steps.

Attachments (stubs included):
- SOC2-report-2025.pdf — SOC 2 Type II report (redacted for customer PII). Scope: Hosted API (data-in-flight and control plane) and Redwood Console (observability).
- pen-test-summary.zip — executive summary + findings matrix (low/medium/high) and remediation ETA.
- DPA-redline-Neha.docx — our DPA with editable redlines; I noted the breach notification SLA and data retention clauses for your legal team.

Summary answers to your items: 
- Logs & retention: Hosted API provides 90-day searchable audit logs by default; we offer export (CSV) and archival to customer-controlled S3 for longer retention. Immutable 12-month retention with search/export is supported on Dedicated or Private deployments; Hosted can be configured to push logs to your S3 for retention but immutability requires Dedicated/Private.
- KMS support: We support AWS KMS and GCP KMS for both Hosted (BYOK for dedicated customers) and Dedicated/Private (full KMS/HSM support). Azure Key Vault support is planned Q2 and we can discuss timelines if required.
- PII redaction: Redwood supports configurable pre-tokenization redaction rules and a post-process redaction pipeline; we can include a demo of how this works in the technical review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Legal/Security review: please confirm by Mon 3/15 if the DPA redline route is acceptable or if you prefer to run counter-redlines.
2) Technical review: propose Tue 3/17 10:00-11:00 PT (we will demo audit logs, KMS configs, and redaction flows). Confirm attendees.
3) Procurement: once legal confirms DPA, we can provide an initial Dedicated trial quote + a Mutual Action Plan for onboarding.

If you'd like, Marissa can join the technical call to walk the pen test remediation items and scope of SOC controls.

Thanks again — looking forward to next steps.

Neha Kapoor
